    Perfect composition pairings through fully faithful functors #

    A natural isomorphism from a covariant representable to a coefficient-dual corepresentable is equivalent to a perfect composition pairing. This file records the part of that construction which is preserved by a fully faithful linear functor. It is used to pass a Nakayama pairing from a deck-orbit category to its full image in a mesh category.
